content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain reduced-fat pancakes are a ready‑to‑mix blend of whole‑grain flour, skimmed milk and a small amount of plant oil. They retain the classic pancake flavor while providing more fiber and less fat, making them a healthier choice for breakfast or a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain flour keeps the bran and germ, boosting B‑vitamins and minerals.
Reduced fat is achieved by using skimmed milk and less oil in the recipe.
The batter cooks quickly – just add water, stir, and fry on a non‑stick pan.
Traditionally pancakes are a symbol of the Russian Maslenitsa festival; the whole‑grain version makes the tradition healthier.
The mix can be stored in a dry place for up to 12 months.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain flour supplies dietary fiber that supports regular bowel movements and promotes satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Reduced fat content helps control calorie intake, useful for weight management.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and niacin aid energy metabolism and support the nervous system.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Iron, magnesium and zinc are present, contributing to blood health and muscle function.

items.title: Supports blood‑sugar stability
items.content: Fiber slows glucose absorption, helping to avoid rapid blood‑sugar spikes after meals.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Whole‑grain flour contains gluten, so the product is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some mixes may contain added salt; those monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Bacterial growth risk
items.content: If batter is left at room temperature for more than 2 hours, bacterial growth can occur; prepare only the portion you will cook immediately.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Dilute the mix with water (or plant‑based milk) as directed, pour thin layers onto a non‑stick skillet without extra oil, and cook until golden. Serve with fresh berries, low‑fat yogurt, nut butter or a drizzle of honey.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the mix in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. After opening, use within 3‑4 weeks. Protect from moisture to prevent clumping and spoilage.
